protocol.missing_future_turn_policy: fail tool use, instruction following, KB grounding, turn-taking, and therefore strict pass
protocol.strict_protocol_completion_definition: all scheduled turns 0..29 observed and end_session called exactly on scheduled turn 29
protocol.latency_policy: TTFAT and raw TTFB are conditional on observed recorded values; missing turns receive no invented latency
protocol.reasoning_token_policy: conditional on observed turns whose provider usage payload contains thinking_tokens
protocol.effect_ci_method: paired whole-conversation bootstrap over the 30 frozen none/low temporal pairs

ttfat_ms.definition: Content-aware time to first assistant text or tool-call token; conditional on an observed scheduled response.

raw_ttfb_ms.definition: Time to the first streamed chunk of any kind; conditional on an observed recorded value.

reasoning_tokens.definition: Provider-reported reasoning tokens for observed scheduled turns whose usage payload included the field.
